title: Joy & Gratitude
intro: Teenagers are sold the idea that joy arrives once the conditions are right — the results, the body, the relationship, the leaving. It does not, and everyone who has chased it that way knows it. This month makes the case for the older route: gratitude as a practice, joy as something deeper than mood, and delight as something God actually intended.

keyScriptures.text: The joy of the Lord is your strength.
Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.

weeks.title: Joy Is Not a Mood
weeks.declaration: Happiness tracks your day. Joy runs underneath it, and it can be present on a day that is objectively bad. That is not denial; it is a different foundation.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give our child a joy that does not depend on the week going well. Root it deeper than their circumstances. Amen.

weeks.title: Gratitude Is a Practice
weeks.declaration: Gratitude is not a personality type you either have or do not. It is a practice, and it works even on days you begin it unwillingly.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make thankfulness a habit in our house rather than a performance. Start with us. Amen.

weeks.title: Comparison Eats It
weeks.declaration: Nothing removes joy faster than measuring your life against an edited version of someone else's. What you are comparing against is not real.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, free our child from the scroll that steals their contentment. Let them look up. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are Allowed to Enjoy This
weeks.declaration: Delight is not a distraction from serious faith. God made a world with taste and music and laughter in it deliberately.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let our child genuinely enjoy their life. Give them things to laugh about in this house that they remember at forty. Amen.

days.title: Not a Mood
days.declaration: Happiness tracks your day. Joy runs underneath it and can survive a day that went badly.

scripture.text: Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

days.title: Not Conditional on Later
days.declaration: Joy that waits for the results, the body, the relationship or the leaving will keep waiting. It is available now or not at all.

scripture.text: I have learned to be content whatever the circumstances.

days.title: Gratitude Is a Practice
days.declaration: Thankfulness is not a personality type. It is a practice, and it works even when you start it unwillingly.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

days.title: Comparison Eats Joy
days.declaration: Nothing removes contentment faster than measuring your life against an edited version of someone else's.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions... without comparing themselves to someone else.

days.title: Name Three
days.declaration: Naming three specific good things is more effective than feeling vaguely grateful. Specific is the whole trick.

scripture.text: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

days.title: Thank People Out Loud
days.declaration: Tell people what they have meant to you while they can still hear it. Do not save it for a speech.

scripture.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

days.title: Enough Today
days.declaration: Contentment is not the absence of ambition. It is the ability to want more without despising what you have.

scripture.text: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

days.title: Joy in the Mess
days.declaration: Joy does not require the situation to be resolved first. It can sit in the middle of an unresolved thing.

scripture.text: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice.

days.title: Good Things Came From Somewhere
days.declaration: Everything good in your life arrived from somewhere. None of it is owed to you, and that makes it better, not worse.

scripture.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above.

days.title: Cynicism Is Cheap
days.declaration: Cynicism costs nothing and protects nothing. It just makes you harder to delight, which is a poor trade.

scripture.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

days.title: You Were Made to Enjoy
days.declaration: God did not have to make food taste of anything. Enjoyment was designed in, not tolerated.

scripture.text: God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

days.title: Rejoice With, Not Against
days.declaration: Being genuinely glad about someone else's win costs you nothing and makes your life larger.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

days.title: Thank Before You See
days.declaration: You can be thankful before you can see how something works out. That is what trust sounds like in practice.

scripture.text: With thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

days.title: Remembering Is a Discipline
days.declaration: Remembering what God has already done is how you get through what He has not done yet.

scripture.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

days.title: Grateful for a Body That Works
days.declaration: Thank God for what your body can do rather than auditing what it looks like. It is carrying you.

scripture.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: Joy Is Not Denial
days.declaration: Being grateful does not mean pretending the hard thing is fine. Both are allowed to be true at once.

scripture.text: Though the fig tree does not bud... yet I will rejoice in the Lord.

days.title: Small and Ordinary
days.declaration: Most of a good life is small and ordinary. If you cannot enjoy the ordinary, the extraordinary will not fix it.

scripture.text: Go, eat your food with gladness, and drink your wine with a joyful heart.

days.title: Put It Down
days.declaration: Some of your joy is being blocked by something you are refusing to put down. Consider putting it down.

scripture.text: Let us throw off everything that hinders.

days.title: Sing Anyway
days.declaration: Singing changes your internal weather faster than thinking does. Do it badly and out loud.

scripture.text: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

days.title: Delighted In Regardless
days.declaration: God delights in you. That is a reason to be glad that is entirely independent of your week.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you... he will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Generosity Makes You Glad
days.declaration: Giving something away reliably makes you happier than keeping it. This is strange and consistently true.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: Presence Over Documentation
days.declaration: Some moments are better lived than recorded. You are allowed to be somewhere without proving it.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything.

days.title: New Every Morning
days.declaration: Every morning is a genuine restart. That alone is worth noticing before you pick up your phone.

scripture.text: His compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

days.title: Joy Others Cannot Remove
days.declaration: There is a kind of joy nobody can take from you, because they did not give it to you.

scripture.text: And no one will take away your joy.

days.title: Grateful for Correction
days.declaration: Even the people who told you hard truths were a gift. Most people will not bother.

scripture.text: Wounds from a friend can be trusted.

days.title: Enjoy What You Are Good At
days.declaration: You are allowed to enjoy being good at something. That is not arrogance, it is using the gift as intended.

scripture.text: There is nothing better for a person than to enjoy their work.

days.title: Contentment Is Learned
days.declaration: Paul said he learned contentment. It is a skill acquired over time, not a temperament you are issued.

scripture.text: I have learned the secret of being content in any and every situation.

days.title: Thankful for Home
days.declaration: Somewhere to come back to is not a given. It is one of the largest things you have.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: More Good Is Coming
days.declaration: Whatever good has already happened, God has not run out. The best is not necessarily behind you.

scripture.text: No good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

days.title: Joy as Strength
days.declaration: Joy is not decoration. It is a load-bearing structure, and it is what will get you through a hard year.

scripture.text: The joy of the Lord is your strength.

days.title: Keep Noticing
days.declaration: The noticing you have practised this month is a habit that works in every month. Keep it.

scripture.text: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances.
